notes.title: A New Update for the VR version of Detached is here!
notes.content:
[h2]Big News from the Detached Universe! 🌌 [/h2]

Attention, space explorers! We’re thrilled to share some exciting news from the Detached cosmos. While you’ve been navigating the zero-gravity challenges of the non-VR version, our sibling project—the original VR version of Detached—[b]has just received a major update! 🎉[/b]

[b]Detached VR[/b] was where it all began—a thrilling, immersive journey through the vastness of space, designed to make you feel like a true astronaut. And now, [b]it’s better than ever![/b] If you’ve enjoyed the non-VR version of Detached and have since added a VR headset to your setup, this is the perfect time to experience the game in its original, fully immersive form.

[previewyoutube=5t8MRGsebK8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Here’s what’s new in this update:[/h2]

[h3][b]✨ Expanded Headset Compatibility[/b][/h3]
We’ve opened the airlocks to welcome more players aboard! Detached now supports a wider range of headsets, so even more space explorers can experience the thrill of navigating the cosmos.
👉 The game supports now Oculus Quest 2/3, Pico 4 Pro/Ultra, Valve Index, and HTC Vive.
[i][b]Note:[/b][/i] Windows Mixed Reality (WMR) is no longer supported due to compatibility issues with the latest Windows 10 and Windows 11 updates.

[h3][b]✨ Updated Default Control Scheme[/b][/h3]
Piloting your ship has never felt smoother. We’ve fine-tuned the controls to ensure they’re perfectly aligned with the capabilities of the latest headsets.
👉 Improved FXP control scheme for Oculus Quest 2/3, Valve Index, and Pico 4 Pro/Ultra. ​​

[h3][b]✨ Bug Fixes and Stability Improvements[/b][/h3]
We’ve patched up some cracks in the hull to ensure your journey through the void is as seamless as possible.
👉 Resolved a crash issue caused by OpenSSL 1.0.2 in Unreal Engine 4.19 on Intel 10th Gen+ processors. The game now uses the updated fix from Unreal Engine 4.22, ensuring smoother performance.

[b]Detached VR[/b] was one of our very first projects, and it’s a game that’s [b]incredibly close to our hearts[/b]. Revisiting it after all these years has been a nostalgic and rewarding journey for us, and [b]we’re so excited to share this updated version with you.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/436230/Detached/
─────────────────────────────────────────────
[h3][b]🎮 Follow Anshar Publishing on Steam 🎮[/b][/h3]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/AnsharPublishing][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/3c16ba5aeabe56c1f0eab668430a5ef5468338da.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Couch Co-op activated!
notes.content:
[h3]We are thrilled to announce that we're taking part in the Couch Co-Op Fest on Steam! [/h3]
This exciting event celebrates games that [b]bring people together[/b], allowing you to enjoy quality time with friends and family from the comfort of your couch.

[b]The Couch Co-Op Fest[/b] is the perfect opportunity to discover new games that emphasize collaboration and shared experiences. Whether you're looking to team up for an adventure or engage in some friendly competition, [b]there's something for everyone[/b].

We're currently working on an update to [b]fix the issues with the game on specific headsets[/b] and [b]improve the control system[/b]. More information will be available soon, so [b]stay tuned![/b]

Don't miss out on this chance to explore a variety of titles and create unforgettable memories with your loved ones. Let's dive into the world of couch co-op gaming together!

notes.title: Coridden is Out Now! 🎉
notes.content:
[h3][b]We are thrilled to announce that Coridden is now available! 🥳[/b][/h3] 
This colourful aRPG is a testament to the love for gaming and will be a treat to any fan of the genre.

[h3][b]See the Launch Trailer:[/b][/h3]
[previewyoutube=O_mnPa8t23A;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Coridden[/b] is an [b]action RPG[/b] where you play as a monster-shifter, able to [b]transform into the creatures you defeat.[/b] Venture out alone or in [b]CO-OP[/b] with [b]up to 3 friends[/b] on a journey to uncover the dark secrets sealed inside the legendary city of Aasha.

🦕 [b]BECOME A SHIFTER[/b] - Switch between your human and beast form freely to utilize each form's strengths and skills when needed.

🏹 [b]ACTION FOCUSED COMBAT[/b] - Experience intense combat action where both your own skill and character gear matters.

⚡️ [b]GROW YOUR POWERS[/b] - Build up both your human and monster form with new gear, attributes, active and passive skills as you level up.

🦹‍♂️ 🦸‍♀️ [b]RIDE OUT SOLO OR IN CO-OP[/b] - Up to 4 players can play together in drop in/drop out co-op gameplay, both locally and online. 

🏇🏻 [b]HOP ON MY BACK[/b] - Ride on each other’s back to become a strong cavalry unit together!

🌺 [b]EXPLORE THE WORLD OF HEERA[/b] - Jump, swim, use fire and break walls to access and explore everything from dangerous caves to old structures, in order to solve quests and find loot.

[h3][b]🐲 Play now![/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1656930/Coridden/

notes.title: Telefrag VR is available now! Let's get to fraggin'!
notes.content:
Gladiators, the wait is over!

[b]Telefrag VR[/b] is now available on [i]Steam Store[/i], [i]Oculus Store[/i], and [i]PlayStation Store[/i]. Make sure you have what it takes to become a space gladiator. Prepare your VR headset and one of the supported controllers (from[i] Touch Controllers[/i] to [i]3dRudder[/i] and [i]PS Aim[/i] (coming soon)!) In case if you still wondering, here's the new Telefrag VR Launch Trailer. Check it out! :) 

[h1][b]WATCH TELEFRAG VR LAUNCH TRAILER[/b][/h1]

https://youtu.be/_oqqPjjnvCo

[b]Compete on 5 unique arenas:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/3416441791721215769]The Fallen Champion[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/1790650479305621608]The Mobius Villa[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/3238563562763926826]The Lazarus Grotto[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/1584619034834529250]The Imperial Shipyard[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/1587997910857016161]The Six Leagues Under[/url]. Each of them will give you a completely different experience, but above all, many challenges. We put in your hands a full arsenal of destruction, inspired by the legendary tools of extermination from the classic 90's FPS games: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/1587997910828357719]Particle Cannon[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/1586870199334744792]Laser Pistol[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/1716342347265826513]Plasma Rifle[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/1716342347256803087]Flak Cannon[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/916100/announcements/detail/1760253077595727194]Rocket Launcher[/url]. Pick the best loadouts, conquer the enemies, and finally make a name for yourself - [b]The Champion.
[/b]

[h1][b]TELEFRAG VR MAIN FEATURES[/b][/h1]

For those who are not following our news, here's the short brief, what are the core features of the game. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34277550/7c157820a99999992c7e2e37891f38750a1d3ad2.jpg[/img]

Telefrag VR is set in an alternative universe where the Roman Empire never collapsed and instead consolidated its power on earth and continued to expand into outer space. The conquering of new systems and races, and development of new technologies ushered in a new era of gladiator battles. 

•	[b]Loadout Management[/b] – Players have a chance to utilize different loadouts, each containing two weapons. Every weapon features two firing modes and a unique teleportation attack.

•	[b]Teleport Attacks and Telefrags[/b] – Teleporting allows players’ contact weapons to inflict “Melee Damage” as they shift from one point of the arena to the next, adding an extra layer to the standard teleport mechanic used in VR.

•	[b]Guns[/b] – Projectile weapons inflict “Ranged Damage” upon the target. The game features well-known classic arena shooter weapons.

•	[b]Fast-Paced matches[/b] – You have two different locomotion types at your disposal. Get comfortable with dash movement or experience, why gladiatorial battles are reserved for the most persistent ones in the free locomotion.

•	[b]Impossible Spaces[/b] – Walkable surfaces can be placed regardless of gravity, allowing the player to travel on any designated surface regardless of its rotation and position relative to the “real” floor. This enables multiple angles of attacks and passages through play space, and as a result a fresh take on competitive level design. 

•	[b]Arena Game Mode[/b] – A 1v1 gameplay mode where the player enters an arena with 5 weapons ready to pick. Choose two of them to compose the best loadout.  We put in your hands (both hands actually) a full arsenal of destruction, inspired by the legendary tools of extermination from the classic 90's FPS games. 


[h1][b]NEED SUPPORT? WANNA PLAY? CONTACT US[/b][/h1]

[IMG]https://i.imgur.com/4o111Ym.jpg[/IMG]

In case of any problems with the game, feel free to contact us, using [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/916100/discussions/1/]Steam forum [/url][/b]or our [b][url=https://discord.gg/xT8nQJ7]Discord channel[/url][/b]. We'll try to investigate the incoming bug reports as soon as possible. Also, make sure that you're on the loop, 'cause our team is ready to rock with you on [b]Telefrag VR[/b] arenas! You will find all the details on Discord.

In behalf of the whole Telefrag VR Team, we hope that Telefrag VR succesfully inject some classic arena shooters vibe to the virtual reality. [b]Let's Get to Fraggin'! [/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/z32drG7.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/916100/Telefrag_VR/

notes.title: Detached: Non-VR Edition is now available
notes.content:
[h1][b]Enter Space Without VR[/b][/h1]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/7YCzbXzWlIza7MiFwE/giphy.gif[/img]

Have you ever wondered what NASA’s requirements are for becoming an astronaut? They’re simple really. You need to have a bachelor’s degree in biology, physics, or math. Three years of experience in the field, or at least 1,000 hours of pilot-in-command time in a jet aircraft. Oh, and excellent vision, obviously. Now, we’re pretty sure neither the first or the second would be a problem for you, but this eagle eye thing… thaaat might be a tiny bit of a problem. Too many night hours spent playing video games had to take its toll on you eventually, eh?

[img]https://i.imgur.com/pftEqDf.jpg[/img]

But don’t give up on your dreams just because your eyesight’s not as sharp as it used to be. Simply grab your copy of [b]Detached[/b], because now the game can be played without VR goggles!

[h1][b]Cross-Platform PvP battles[/b][/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6xoW3PQ.png[/img]

[b]Detached[/b] in the non-VR version contains a full single player campaign, thanks to which you will try to survive in an extremely difficult environment - a cosmic abyss where each of your movements must be countered. Master the possibilities of your suit and explore the abandoned space station.

From now on you can also fight in the PvP cross-platform mode, thanks to which you will fight with players who have not only the non-VR version, but also the version on [i]Oculus Rift, HTC Vive and PS VR[/i].

You are not sure if it is worth starting the battle in two multipurpose modes? Take advantage of the free demo that allows you to test both single player mode and fun in the Package Extraction mode.

So... let's have so fun in space! :) 

If you want to learn more about Detached game, visit the game website or follow us on Twitter or Facebook. Feel free to contact us!

[url=http://detachedgame.com/]Website[/url]
[url=https://www.facebook.com/DetachedGame/]Facebook[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/detachedgame]Twitter[/url]
